children: The weekly USDA Crop Progress report shows the U.S. soybean harvest almost catching up with the 5-year average pace for this time of year. The data shows 64% of the soybean harvest is complete, versus the 5-year average of 65%. Corn remains behind the 5-year pace, with 44% of the harvest complete, versus the 5-year average of 52%. "The corn harvest continues to lag expectations but should pick up this week thanks to dry Midwest weather," says Matt Zeller of StoneX in a note. "Yield anecdotes and expectations remain mostly strong here in the heart of the belt." CBOT grain futures are lower midday, with corn down 0.9%, soybeans off 0.4%, and wheat 1.5% lower. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
